name: cord.com
summary: A light recruiting-marketplace style with white canvas, navy-first text, one signal-blue action color, Figtree typography, rounded company cards, authentic photography, and blue-tinted shadows.

midnightHarbor.role: Primary text, headings, logo grounding, dark CTA banner

signalBlue.role: Primary action, logo wordmark, active nav, selected states

slateChannel.role: Secondary text, muted icons, outlined links

iceTint.role: Hover wash, active toggle fill, input tint, status badge fill

components.primaryCta: Signal Blue filled pill button with white text and Figtree 16px weight 600.
components.heroSearchInput: Wide white pill input with sea-fog border, left icon, and keyboard hint chip.
components.toggleSwitch: Two-segment pill selector with Ice Tint active side and navy active text.
components.companyCard: Rounded white card with full-bleed company photo, logo, name, meta row, status badge, and response text.
components.darkCtaBanner: Full-bleed Midnight Harbor banner with white headline, sea-fog copy, blue CTA, and avatar stack.
components.filterChip: White chip with sea-fog border, 8px radius, navy text, and optional muted icon.
components.footerColumn: Four-column footer link group with navy headings and slate-channel links.

dos: Use Midnight Harbor for all primary text and headings.
Reserve Signal Blue for logo, primary action, and active states.
Use 20-24px radii on cards, buttons, and inputs.
Use Sea Fog for all hairlines and borders.
donts: Do not introduce a second accent color.
Do not use pure black for text.
Do not use sharp corners on cards or buttons.
Do not add generic gray shadows.
Do not use light weights for display headlines.
Do not use Signal Blue for body text or large headings.
Do not repeat the dark CTA banner throughout the page.
